## Checklist

- [ ] The change fits the single execution model: `match → source → transform → response`.
- [ ] I checked related ADRs under `plans/adr/` and noted any conflict.
- [ ] I updated documentation when behavior or contracts changed.
- [ ] I added or updated the smallest useful test for non-trivial logic.
- [ ] No customer data, secrets, tokens, internal hostnames, production logs, request bodies, or response bodies are included.
- [ ] Commit messages are in English and commits are signed off with `git commit -s`.
